summary.text: David Boyer is a Republican state representative from Poland, Maine, who has represented House District 87 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His background includes owning DB Consulting and working in Maine political and advocacy organizations.

paragraphs.text: His career experience includes owning DB Consulting and working as the Maine political director of the Marijuana Policy Project, the campaign manager of Eric Brakey's 2018 U.S. Senate campaign, and the executive director of the Defense of Liberty PAC.
Boyer has been affiliated with the Sportsman Alliance of Maine, Maine Organic Farmers and Gardeners, the Androscoggin Land Trust, and Ellie's Legacy Animal Foundation.
Boyer assumed office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, succeeding Jeffery Hanley.
During 2023 and 2024 he served on the Elections Committee and the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee, and for 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Elections Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
